Kavya Rao: Capturing quick runtime roadmap Q&A follow-ups here — short thread for actions.
Noah Kim: Can you confirm p95 numbers and whether they include warm cache? I ran benchmarks and saw variance.
Kavya Rao: Hosted p95 target = 120ms (8k context, warm steady-state). Dedicated SLA = 100ms p95. We'll add a separate cold-start metric in docs.
Sofia Alvarez: Are these targets tied to quantized paths only? Some teams test fp16 which looks different.
Kavya Rao: Targets assume our default quantized serving (int8/4bit). FP16 typically +10–25ms depending on model.
Ruth Chang: Batching: is latency_budget_ms per-route? We had a regression when global dynamic-batching turned on.
Kavya Rao: Yes — default runtime uses latency-first batching (stop when latency_budget_ms or max_batch_size hit). Per-route overrides let you opt into throughput-first batching. We'll publish the config snippet.
Noah Kim: Please include a tiny YAML example I can paste into perf runner.
Kavya Rao: Will do by EOD.
sre-oncall: KV cache eviction question: tenant saw tail spikes when global pressure ran.
Sofia Alvarez: Short mitigation: bump tenant TTL, reduce eviction pressure. Long-term: LRU with protected recent prefixes and eviction_reason metrics.
Kavya Rao: Runtime to publish eviction policy doc + metrics: eviction_count, eviction_reason, eviction_ttl_expiry.
Noah Kim: Tracing: can we get kernel-level spans (matmul/attn/softmax) surfaced in Console? Current spans are coarse.
Kavya Rao: Yes — adding kernel_name/kernel_ms/kernel_device spans behind feature flag next sprint.
Ruth Chang: Hotpatch fallback: we had a canary where hotpatch partially applied and some requests hung. Who owns trace dive?
Kavya Rao: Runtime + SRE. Please drop trace ids here.
Ruth Chang: trace-2026-11-10-77 and trace-2026-11-10-83.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: runtime/kernel-vector-proto -> canary group delta (job 9781) :rocket:
Kavya Rao: Actions: Noah to get YAML test snippet, Runtime to publish eviction doc and enable kernel spans behind flag, SRE+Runtime to investigate hang traces. I'll post rollout checklist and monitoring signals tonight. Ping me for any blockers.
Noah Kim: thanks — will watch the canary metrics.
Sofia Alvarez: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
